fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
fields.notes: ACE / IHI 0022E does not specify DFT / scan / BIST / MBIST / boundary scan. The protocol defines only functional signaling. Concrete coherent IP blocks (CPU clusters, system caches, coherency managers) add standard scan insertion + DFT compression + boundary scan during SoC integration; debug visibility is typically provided via ARM CoreSight, JTAG (IEEE 1149.1), and trace components — all outside the scope of this protocol spec. The ACE-defined CRRESP[1] Error bit is the closest functional observability for snoop failures and may be wired into a system-level coherency monitor for trace/debug.
closest_protocol_observability: CRRESP[1] Error — cached master signals a snoop failure.
DECERR default-slave injection — undecoded coherent transactions caught at interconnect.

evidence.quote: CRRESP[1] Error bit indicates a snoop failure in the cached master.
